parameters.query:
SELECT COALESCE(intent, 'unclassified') AS intent, COUNT(*)::int AS n
FROM messages
WHERE received_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC;

SELECT id, category, assigned_to, status, notify_status, created_at, sla_due_at,
       (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - created_at)) / 60)::int AS age_min
FROM escalations
WHERE status IN ('open','claimed')
ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 50;

SELECT event, COUNT(*)::int AS n
FROM audit_log
WHERE event IN ('duplicate_ignored','low_confidence','notify_failed','send_failed',
                'signature_invalid','malformed_payload','workflow_error')
  AND ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY event;
SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS breaches FROM escalations WHERE status = 'open' AND sla_due_at < now();
